_comment: anyloop:fsm -- the whole steering loop as one pipeline stage.
Runs on nothing but a synthetic source, so it needs no camera and
This is the REPLAY shape: the source already supplies the [y,x]
error, so there is no `sensor` role and the composite is
controller -> clamp -> actuator. On the bench the source is the
camera plugin and `sensor` holds center_of_mass or fit_com; the
stages are otherwise identical, and they run in role order no
matter what order these keys are written in.
stand-in for camera + center_of_mass: a [y, x] error that
swings +-0.8 of the frame, which the clamp below will not
let all the way through to the mirror.

_sensor: On the bench this role holds the wavefront sensor:

controller._comment: fsp on the bench; pid needs no identified plant

_comment: a tap: an array runs its entries in order, so
this logger sees the controller's command. In
the sensor array it would see the measured
error instead. This is where the udp_sink and
file_sink entries of a flat steering config go.

_actuator: stand-in for anyloop:parport_dac. The park write at
exit goes through this stage, so the last vector
logged is the parked command rather than a control
